content.text:
Done. Summary of what was added in this commit:

**DB-derived (CF Worker reads directly from Hyperdrive):**
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId` — single plugin record (was 501)
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/dashboard` — diagnostics with worker:null + recent jobs/webhooks/health (was 501)
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/health` — registry/manifest/status checks
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/config` — plugin instance config
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs` — job list (filterable by status)
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/runs` — paginated run history

**Sidecar-proxied (process-dependent):**
- `DELETE /api/plugins/:pluginId` — uninstall
- `POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/{enable,disable,upgrade}` — lifecycle
- `GET /api/plugins/:pluginId/logs` — in-process logs
- `POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/config` + `/config/test` — needs validateConfig
- `POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/trigger`
- `POST /api/plugins/:pluginId/webhooks/:endpointKey`
- All `bridge/*`, `data/:key`, `actions/:key` endpoints
- `GET /api/plugins/tools` + `POST /api/plugins/tools/execute`

The CF dashboard returns `worker: null` (no worker process in Workers); the UI gracefully handles this by hiding worker-status panels. When the sidecar is unreachable, sidecar-proxied routes return a 503 with a helpful message rather than a confusing 501.

Refresh the page — `/api/plugins/:pluginId` and `/api/plugins/:pluginId/dashboard` should now return 200.
